subject: Post-demo: buying journey owners, legal lane and contract sequencing (ClinicSoft)
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@clinicsoft.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 15:23:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo: buying journey owners, legal lane and contract sequencing (ClinicSoft)

Hi Elena — thanks again for the demo time earlier. Quick recap and recommended next steps so we keep momentum: 

Summary of signals
- Primary use case: embeddings + retrieval for internal clinical knowledge base (fast, private).
- Required security artifacts: SOC 2 scope, DPA (standard), and customer-managed logging for audits.
- Timing: PO/contract target ~end of Q1 (internal procurement windows).

Proposed owner map (suggested)
- Economic buyer: Asha Verma (procurement lead) — final pricing decision.
- Security reviewer: Miguel Santos (infosec) — runs DPA review and SOC scope.
- Legal / contracting: Legal Ops (legal_ops@clinicsoft.com) — will own NDA/MSA redlines.

Contract sequencing recommendation
1) NDA short-form to enable SSO & security exchange (kick-off today if possible).
2) DPA review concurrent with pilot SOW (we can provide a draft DPA).
3) MSA / Order Form redlines after pilot acceptance (limit scope to inference endpoints to speed sign-off).

Turn-time assumptions (we should confirm)
- NDA: 2–4 business days (assuming short redlines)
- DPA: 5–10 business days (depends on vendor clauses)
- MSA: 7–15 business days (assuming 1–2 rounds of redlines)

Attachments: demo notes + a placeholder NDA template I can send to Legal Ops.

Next steps / asks for ClinicSoft
- Can you confirm the names/roles for Asha and Miguel so we can loop them in?
- Is Legal Ops comfortable receiving a first-pass NDA from us today? If yes, I will send the short-form NDA and copy Marissa.

Internal note (Marissa/Karthik): if Legal Ops asks for a shorter SOW-first path, we can offer a timeboxed pilot with DPA + limited data retention settings to minimize legal friction.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min sync if useful.

— Jonas
Jonas Weber | Sr. Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Thanks Jonas — helpful summary. Quick answers below: 

- Asha Verma (asha.verma@clinicsoft.com) is indeed the procurement/econ owner.
- Miguel Santos (miguel.santos@clinicsoft.com) will handle infosec review.
- Legal Ops (copied) is the right lane for NDA/MSA.

We would welcome the NDA today — Legal Ops will triage. On timelines: we generally hit 3–7 business days for short NDAs, DPA will need a little more time (testing with our security team).

One additional constraint: our legal team prefers the pilot SOW to explicitly state data residency and retention (30 days logs only) — can you confirm Redwood can support that?

Elena
Elena Torres
Head of Product Operations | ClinicSoft
